name: Sumeragi Kazumitsu
source:
A freshman belonging to the Faculty of Letters at R University.

He is one of the few friends [url=https://vndb.org/c93026]Akito[/url] has and often plays chess with him. A good-natured person, he is the complete opposite of Akito in terms of personality.  He works part-time as a cram school tutor, with one of his students being [url=/c93031]Nakashima Jirou[/url]. 

He is involved in a case alongside Akito.

[Translated from [url=http://creo.main.jp/page/product/loot/Character/loot_cha_kazumitsu.html]official website[/url]]
